title: Hezekiah's Sickness and Recovery

questions.question: In those days Hezekiah became sick and was at the point of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 38:1 (ESV): "sick and was at the point of death."

questions.question: Isaiah said to him, "Thus says the LORD: Set your house in order, for you shall die, you shall not what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 38:1 (ESV): "for you shall die, you shall not recover."

questions.question: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and did what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 38:2 (ESV): "Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD,"

questions.question: I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add to your life how many years?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 38:5 (ESV): "Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life."

questions.question: What was the sign that the shadow would go back ten steps?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 38:8 (ESV): "Behold, I will make the shadow cast by the declining sun... turn back ten steps."

questions.question: I said, In the middle of my days I must depart; I am consigned to the gates of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 38:10 (ESV): "I am consigned to the gates of Sheol"

questions.question: Like a swallow or a crane I chirp; I moan like a what?
Behold, it was for my welfare that I had great what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 38:17 (ESV): "Behold, it was for my welfare that I had great bitterness;"

questions.question: For you have cast all my sins behind your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 38:17 (ESV): "for you have cast all my sins behind your back."

questions.question: For Sheol does not thank you; death does not praise you; those who go down to the pit do not hope for your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 38:18 (ESV): "do not hope for your faithfulness."

questions.question: The living, the living, he thanks you, as I do this day; the father makes known to the children your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 38:19 (ESV): "makes known to the children your faithfulness."

questions.question: Now Isaiah had said, "Let them take a cake of what and apply it to the boil, that he may recover?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 38:21 (ESV): "Let them take a cake of figs"

questions.question: On whose steps did the sun turn back?
Like a weaver I have rolled up my life; he cuts me off from the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 38:12 (ESV): "he cuts me off from the loom;"

questions.question: Who makes the father know to the children God's faithfulness?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 38:19 (ESV): "the father makes known to the children your faithfulness."

key_verse_text: Go and say to Hezekiah, Thus says the LORD, the God of David your father: I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.
